OpenSSL 3.5.4 (static)
https://github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/download/openssl-3.5.4/openssl-3.5.4.tar.gz

Android NDK 28.2.13676358
ABI arm64-v8a
API 26
Linker -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384
TLS on, video off in config_site.h, SRTP disabled at runtime
CA bundle: Mozilla cacert.pem from https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem
